DIRECTION 05 — GROVE. Sophisticated Nordic botanical modernism; restorative, quietly optimistic, an organic alternative to loud technology brands. Palette pine green #244F3B, pale chartreuse #D4E796, flax white #F2F0E5, deep green-black #182B22. ONE emblem: a single continuous bold rounded organic loop with two unequal petal-like lobes and one gently offset opening, suggestive of sheltering and growth rather than a literal leaf or flower; compact, asymmetric, flat solid fill, simple enough to stamp. No plant illustration as the logo. Bespoke Aarre wordmark in a friendly moderately wide humanist sans with beautifully open counters and a subtle organic lower-case rr rhythm; confident, not childish.
COMPOSITION: A large pine-green editorial field carries a cream Aarre wordmark and exact headline "Ideas take root." beside a huge pale-chartreuse emblem crop. A narrow photographic column of sunlit fern shadows and natural paper adds atmosphere; high-end art photography, not environmental stock advertising. Across the lower half show a generous warm-white Aarre browser collection with saved art, architecture and nature cards; a small compact save panel and right-side handle carry the same pine emblem. A small beautifully aligned side panel holds an Aa specimen, color chips and app icon light/dark. Rounded geometry is quiet, not bubbly. Use restrained botanical textures only in editorial areas, clean readable UI. Expressive and original design-studio branding; green is luminous and alive, never generic corporate eco branding.
